name: csmw-coder
description: Build a Python module on the side: two model sides of different vendors, plan, frozen contract, verification design, isolated build, verification run, with code deciding every step. Started from a session through the workflow's MCP tools, runs detached, never writes back into the session.

harness_path.title: Runtime checkout
harness_path.description: Path to the runtime package checkout the workflow runs on (default: cloned into the plugin's data dir with gh)

runs_dir.title: Runs directory
runs_dir.description: Where runs live (default: ~/.csmw/runs), outside any project so a session's repo stays clean
